avatars.history: First avatar Satya Yuga. Vaivasvata Manu first man performing ablutions river Kritamala — tiny fish came in hands begged protection. Manu put in pot → grew → river → ocean. Fish revealed as Vishnu warned of great deluge pralaya in 7 days. Manu built boat with Saptarishi 7 sages, Vedas, seeds of all plants, animals. Matsya towed boat with rope via Shesha as rope to Mount Himavan. Hayagriva asura stole Vedas from Brahma sleeping — Matsya killed Hayagriva restored Vedas. Symbol evolution fish first life water.

avatars.history: Second avatar Satya Yuga Samudra Manthan churning ocean of milk. Devas Asuras churned for amrita immortality using Mount Mandara as churning rod and Vasuki serpent as rope. Mandara started sinking — Vishnu as giant tortoise Kurma went under ocean supported Mandara on back. 14 ratnas emerged: Lakshmi, Kaustubha gem, Parijata tree, Varuni wine, Dhanvantari with amrita, Chandra moon, Kamadhenu cow, Airavata elephant, Uchhaishravas horse, etc. Mohini avatar Vishnu female distributed amrita to Devas tricked Asuras. Halahala poison emerged Shiva drank became Neelkanth.
avatars.value: Support stability, balance, foundation, patience, sacrifice back to support world, cooperation Devas Asuras despite enmity for common goal.
avatars.benefits: Stability in life, support during churning chaos, patience, foundation for success, balance, removes sinking feeling.

avatars.values: Support silently without credit, Stability foundation for others to succeed, Patience tortoise slow steady wins, Cooperation even enemies can cooperate for bigger goal.

avatars.history: Fourth avatar Satya Yuga. Hiranyakashipu asura brother Hiranyaksha killed by Varaha — did severe penance Brahma boon: not killed by man nor animal, not inside nor outside, not day nor night, not earth nor sky, not by weapon, not by any created being. Became invincible tyrant, son Prahlada devotee Vishnu — father tried to kill Prahlada many ways: poison, fire Holika, elephants, snakes — Prahlada saved by Vishnu. Hiranyakashipu asked 'Where is your Vishnu? In this pillar?' Hit pillar — pillar burst Narasimha half man half lion emerged at twilight sandhya neither day night, on threshold doorway neither inside outside, on lap thighs neither earth sky, with nails not weapon, killed Hiranyakashipu tore chest. Prahlada became king devotee.
avatars.value: Protection of devotees at any cost, destruction of tyranny despite boons loopholes, dharma finds way, devotion > power, fierce compassion.
avatars.benefits: Protection from enemies tyrants, removes fear, grants courage, protection from evil, legal victory, removes black magic, Prahlada bhakti grants Vishnu love.

avatars.history: Fifth avatar Treta Yuga start. Bali king asura grandson Prahlada — became very powerful virtuous but asura guru Shukracharya told do 100 Ashwamedha yagna to become Indra. Devas scared asked Vishnu help. Vishnu as Vamana dwarf Brahmin boy 5ft with umbrella kamandalu. Went to Bali yagna — Bali offered boon — Vamana asked 3 steps land. Shukracharya warned its Vishnu — Bali said promise is promise. Vamana grew to Trivikrama giant: first step Earth, second sky heavens, third where? Bali offered head — Vamana pushed Bali to Patala netherworld but blessed Bali to be Indra next Manvantara and visit earth once yearly Onam festival Kerala. Bali's devotion greater than Indra.

avatars.benefits: Humility, removes ego pride, grants 3 worlds if surrender like Bali, Onam prosperity, Kerala harvest, promise keeping.

avatars.history: Sixth avatar Treta Yuga. Son of Jamadagni Rishi and Renuka, descendant Bhrigu. Learned weapons from Shiva got Parashu axe. Kshatriyas became tyrant — Kartavirya Arjuna Haihaya king 1000 arms stole Jamadagni's Kamadhenu wish cow. Parashurama killed Kartavirya. Kartavirya sons killed Jamadagni. Parashurama vowed 21 times wiped Kshatriyas from earth filled 5 lakes with blood. Gave earth to Kashyapa Rishi and went to Mahendra mountain penance. Still alive as Chiranjeevi immortal — will be guru of Kalki next avatar. Created Kerala Konkan coast — threw axe from Gokarna to sea sea retreated created Parashurama Kshetra Kerala Konkan coast.

avatars.benefits: Justice against oppression, warrior strength for Brahmins, removes Kshatriya ego, grants land Kerala Konkan, immortal blessings, martial arts.

avatars.history: Seventh avatar Treta Yuga. Son of Dasharatha Kaushalya Ayodhya king Raghu dynasty. Four brothers Rama Lakshmana Bharata Shatrughna — Rama Vishnu, Lakshmana Shesha, Bharata Shankha chakra, Shatrughna. Married Sita daughter Janaka Mithila found in furrow earth — Sita Lakshmi avatar. 14 years exile due to Kaikeyi boon Bharata king — Rama went forest with Sita Lakshmana. Ravana Lanka king 10 heads Brahmin scholar 6 shastras 4 Vedas devotee Shiva kidnapped Sita. Rama with Hanuman Sugriva Vanara army built Ram Setu bridge to Lanka killed Ravana. Returned Ayodhya Diwali — Bharata ruled with Paduka on throne 14 years waiting — ideal brother Bharat. Ruled Ram Rajya ideal kingdom 11k years. Sita Agni Pariksha fire test, later exile to Valmiki ashram gave birth Lava Kusha twins who sang Ramayana. Rama Jal Samadhi Sarayu river.
